finding.title: Stop interpolating raw error.toString() into localized error messages across progress screens
finding.rule: EH-5 / custom_lint no_e_to_string_in_ui (currently enforcing nothing repo-wide)
finding.why: error.toString() on a Dart/Firebase/Drift exception is always in English (e.g. 'Bad state: ...', 'SqliteException: ...') and not ICU-pluralizable; interpolating it into an otherwise-Hebrew ARB string means a Hebrew-locale, RTL user who hits any of these error states sees a sentence that switches to raw untranslated English mid-string. recent_activity_screen.dart in the same directory shows the correct pattern (l10n.chartFailedToLoad with no error interpolation, 4 uses) — the other 4 screens in this same feature diverge from it.
finding.recommendation: Replace error.toString() interpolation with the generic localized failure string (as recent_activity_screen.dart already does) and, if diagnostic detail is genuinely needed, log error.toString() via AppLogger instead of rendering it to the user.
acceptance_criteria: None of the 4 screens' AsyncValue.error branches call .toString() on the error object inside a Text/l10n call.
Once dart run custom_lint is repaired, no_e_to_string_in_ui reports zero hits in lib/features/progress/.

finding.title: Add a semantic label to the custom back IconButton in recent_activity_screen.dart
finding.why: This is a hand-rolled header row, not AppBar's automatic leading back button, so Flutter supplies no implicit semantics label here. A screen-reader user (TalkBack/VoiceOver) tabbing to this control hears only 'button' with no indication it navigates back, on a screen reachable from every Progress-hub session.
finding.recommendation: Add tooltip: l10n.<existing back-button key> (or a new ARB key) to the IconButton so it gets both a visible tooltip and a screen-reader label.
acceptance_criteria: A semantics test (or manual VoiceOver/TalkBack pass) confirms the back control announces a localized label.

finding.title: Split the 6 progress-feature files that exceed the 400-line AG-3 cap
finding.why: Large files raise the cost of every future change (more to read/hold in context before a safe edit, bigger diffs, more merge conflicts) and are the six biggest files in the batch. Two of them (chart_data_service.dart, the items_learned/lifetime_knowledge provider pair) are also where the duplication findings above live — size and duplication are compounding here, not independent problems.
finding.recommendation: Split along the seams already visible: chart_data_service.dart by chart type or into a shared bucketizer module (after collapsing the *Live duplicates); lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart / items_learned_providers.dart by extracting the private helpers into lifetime_tree_builder.dart per finding #1; recent_activity_screen.dart by moving chart-body/card widgets into presentation/widgets/.
acceptance_criteria: An AG-3 line-count checker (once it exists per Rule 0) reports 0 hand-written files >400 lines under lib/features/progress/.

finding.title: Replace hand-rolled ==/hashCode on PaceCalculator, LifetimeLeafProvenance and RecentActivityWindow with @freezed or a record
finding.rule: naming/placement — domain/state models are @freezed; never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes
finding.why: Three separate hand-written equality implementations exist in this one feature slice alongside a fourth model file (journey_view_model.dart) that correctly uses @freezed for the same kind of value object, and alongside sibling family-key records elsewhere in this same batch (e.g. lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart's ({int profileId, CurriculumId curriculumId})) that get structural equality for free. Hand-rolled equality is exactly the boilerplate freezed exists to generate and keep in sync; PaceCalculator's == only compares 6 of its 13 fields (the derived ones are excluded) which is easy to get wrong silently the next time a field is added, since nothing forces == and hashCode to be touched together.
finding.recommendation: Convert PaceCalculator and LifetimeLeafProvenance to @freezed classes (both fit the private-const-factory-plus-named-computing-factory pattern already used elsewhere for derived-field value objects); convert RecentActivityWindow to a named-field record (({DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, String? curriculumId})) to match the record-based family keys already used in this same feature.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'bool operator ==' lib/features/progress/ (excluding .freezed.dart/.g.dart) returns no hits.

finding.title: Localize the hardcoded 'Curriculum settings' tooltip in curriculum_progress_screen.dart
finding.why: Every other string on this screen goes through AppLocalizations (l10n.curriculumProgressBreakdownByLevel, l10n.errorUnknownCurriculum, etc.); this one literal renders in English regardless of device locale, so a Hebrew-locale, RTL user long-pressing the settings gear sees an English tooltip in an otherwise fully-Hebrew screen.
finding.recommendation: Add an ARB key (EN+HE) and use l10n.<key> instead of the literal.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity stays green with the new key present in both app_en.arb and app_he.arb.
The tooltip: parameter on this IconButton references an l10n getter, not a string literal.
